Ravi (CEO): Thanks everyone for joining today's all-hands. Quick thread to collect links + owners for follow-ups. I'll drop the recording now — pls add asks you want tracked.

Ops Bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.cloud/recordings/ah-2026-03-23 (permissions: company). Slides uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/AH-Mar-23-2026/AH-Mar-23-2026.pdf

Anya (Product): Can we confirm Dedicated GA date? In slides it said 'H2', can we be more specific? Also who owns the rollout checklist?

Matt R: Committed GA target: 2026-08-01 (tentative). Owning: Jules + Eng-Platform. I'll create a GH epic and link it here.

Jules (Eng): :thumbsup: I'll own the checklist. Will post draft by Mon 2026-03-30. Need input from SRE/security on runbooks and fallback policies.

Sarah L: Security: we'll produce a compliance matrix and checklist. I'm owning the first pass. Target: 2026-04-06.

Maya (People Ops): Hiring update: JD for infra/SRE lead is in final review. Expect to post job by Fri 2026-03-27.

Anya (Product): Great — can someone own pricing FAQ for Dedicated? Marketing needs copy and a short one-pager for sales enablement.

Matt R: Assigning pricing FAQ to Sarah + Clara. @Clara (Marketing) can you take point on copy? If you need engineering details, tag me.

Clara (Marketing): On it. Will draft skeleton and sync with Sarah on Tue 2026-03-31.

Ravi (CEO): Two rapid leadership asks from the Q&A: 1) Private deployment timeline — can we clarify pilot dates? 2) Hiring request — what's blocked on approvals?

Jules (Eng): Private pilot: aiming for late Q2 (pilot customers onboarded by 2026-06-20). Will surface the pilot plan doc this week.

Maya (People Ops): Hiring approvals: budget ok, just waiting on final signoff from finance; expect green light next Wed.

Anya (Product): Action items summary (add owners/links if missing):
1) Recording + slides — Ops Bot (links above)
2) Dedicated GA epic — Matt R
3) Rollout checklist — Jules (draft by 2026-03-30)
4) Compliance matrix — Sarah L (2026-04-06)
5) Pricing FAQ + one-pager — Clara (Marketing)
6) Private pilot plan — Jules

Ops Bot: Added all items to the all-hands project board: https://app.project/boards/ah-followups. Tickets: AH-101, AH-102, AH-103.

Matt R: I'll set up a 30m cross-functional sync next Wed (2026-04-01) to align owners. Invite coming shortly.

Sarah L: Also: let's include a small prompt-eval suite to catch quality regressions with quantized models. Product, can you provide ~10 test prompts?

Anya (Product): I'll drop a 10-prompt eval set in this thread by EOD tomorrow.

Liam (Support): Can we get a short support FAQ (top 10 questions) so we can prep triage playbooks? I'll collect inbound tickets this week.

Ravi (CEO): Thanks everyone — please update the board and link artifacts. I'll check back EOD Friday for progress. :rocket:
